instruction: Create two sections: 1) Use <h2> for "My Wishlist" followed by an unordered list with: New book, Coffee mug, Headphones. 2) Use <h2> for "My Tasks" followed by an ordered list with: Finish homework, Study for the exams, Clean the kitchen.
correct_code:
My Wishlist

  • New book
  • Coffee mug
  • Headphones

My Tasks

  1. Finish homework
  2. Study for the exams
  3. Clean the kitchen

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Excellent work! You've created both unordered and ordered lists with proper structure. You understand when to use <ul> for items without order and <ol> for sequential items!

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Remember: Use <h2> for headings, <ul> with <li> for the wishlist (unordered), and <ol> with <li> for tasks (ordered). Make sure each list item is wrapped in <li> tags!
